info.title: Nacos Console API
info.description: Nacos Console API openAPI(swagger) type document

tags.name: Nacos Console Naming Center Service APIs
tags.description: Operations related to services in the Nacos Console Naming Center, including creating/deleting services, listing services, retrieving service details, querying service subscribers, and more.

tags.name: Nacos Console Service Instance APIs
tags.description: Operations related to service instances in the Nacos Naming Center, including retrieving instance lists, updating instance metadata, and deleting persistent instances.

tags.name: Nacos Console Configuration History APIs
tags.description: Operations related to configuration history versions in the Nacos Console Configuration Center, including retrieving historical version lists, viewing details of historical versions, and more.

tags.name: Nacos Console Configuration Center APIs
tags.description: Nacos Console operations for the configuration center, including retrieving configuration lists, fetching configuration details, publishing configurations, deleting configurations, batch deletion, searching configurations, listening for configuration changes, exporting configurations, importing configurations, and more.

tags.name: Nacos Console Health Check APIs
tags.description: Routines to check the health status of the Nacos console.

tags.name: Nacos Console Plugin APIs
tags.description: Routines to manage Nacos plugins: list plugins, get plugin detail, update plugin status or configuration, and query plugin availability across cluster nodes.

tags.name: Nacos Console State APIs
tags.description: Retrieve the Nacos console's state, announcements, and guidance content.

tags.name: Nacos Console Cluster APIs
tags.description: Routines to retrieve cluster information for the Nacos-controlled cluster.

tags.name: Nacos Console Namespace APIs
tags.description: Routines to manage namespaces in the Nacos console: list, retrieve, create, update, delete namespaces, and validate namespace IDs.

tags.name: Nacos Console AI Copilot Related APIs
tags.description: Nacos Console AI Copilot API operations, including skill optimize/generate, prompt optimize/debug stream endpoints.

tags.name: Nacos Console AI Pipeline Query APIs
tags.description: Pipeline execution record query API for the console, supporting single record retrieval and paginated listing.

tags.name: Nacos AI Resource Import APIs
tags.description: APIs for importing Nacos AI resources, including listing sources, searching external resources, validating selected items, and executing imports.

tags.name: Nacos Console AI AgentSpec Admin APIs
tags.description: AgentSpec admin API operations for the console, including get, delete, list, and upload.

tags.name: Nacos Console AI A2A Related APIs
tags.description: Nacos Console AI A2A API operations, including listing, creating, querying, updating, and deleting AgentCards.

tags.name: Nacos Console AI Prompt Related APIs
tags.description: Nacos Console AI Prompt API operations, including publish, get metadata/detail, bind/unbind label, delete, list, version list, and update metadata.

tags.name: Nacos Console AI Copilot Config Related APIs
tags.description: Nacos Console AI Copilot config API operations, including get and save config (apiKey, model, studioUrl, studioProject only).

tags.name: Nacos Console AI MCP Service Related APIs
tags.description: API operations for managing AI MCP services in the Nacos Console, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting MCP services.

tags.name: Nacos Console AI Skill Related APIs
tags.description: Nacos Console AI Skill API operations, including register, get, update, delete, list, and upload Skill.

tags: Nacos Console Plugin APIs

tags: Nacos Console Plugin APIs

schema.description: JSON object string parsed as plugin configuration

tags: Nacos Console Naming Center Service APIs
get.description: This interface retrieves detailed information of a specified service, including metadata and configuration.

tags: Nacos Console Naming Center Service APIs
put.description: This interface updates metadata of a service (e.g., `metadata`, `selector`). Immutable fields include `serviceName`, `groupName`, and `namespaceId`.

schema.description: JSON object string parsed as service selector
JSON object string parsed as service metadata

tags: Nacos Console Naming Center Service APIs
post.description: This interface creates an empty service.

schema.description: JSON object string parsed as service selector
JSON object string parsed as service metadata

tags: Nacos Console Naming Center Service APIs
delete.description: This interface deletes a service. Note: This is service deletion, NOT instance deletion. A service cannot be deleted if it has existing service instances.

tags: Nacos Console Naming Center Service APIs
put.description: This interface updates metadata for a specific service cluster.

schema.description: JSON object string parsed as cluster health checker
JSON object string parsed as cluster metadata

tags: Nacos Console Service Instance APIs
put.description: This interface updates metadata of specified service instances (e.g., `weight`, `enabled`). Unmodifiable fields include `serviceName`, `groupName`, `namespace`, `IP`, and `port`.

schema.description: JSON object string parsed as instance metadata

tags: Nacos Console Service Instance APIs
delete.description: This interface deletes a persistent instance from the specified service. The console does not support deleting ephemeral instances.

schema.description: JSON object string parsed as instance metadata

tags: Nacos Console Namespace APIs
get.description: Renders detailed information of a specific namespace.

tags: Nacos Console Namespace APIs
put.description: Updates non-ID attributes of a namespace (e.g., name, description). The namespace ID itself cannot be modified.

tags: Nacos Console Namespace APIs
post.description: Creates a new namespace with a custom ID and metadata.

tags: Nacos Console Namespace APIs
delete.description: Deletes a namespace. The default `public` namespace cannot be deleted.

data.name: GeoSpatial Route Planner Agent
data.description: Provides advanced route planning, traffic analysis, and custom map generation services. This agent can calculate optimal routes, estimate travel times considering real-time traffic, and create personalized maps with points of interest.

skills.name: Traffic-Aware Route Optimizer
skills.description: Calculates the optimal driving route between two or more locations, taking into account real-time traffic conditions, road closures, and user preferences (e.g., avoid tolls, prefer highways).
tags: maps
routing
navigation
directions
traffic
examples: Plan a route from '1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA' to 'San Francisco International Airport' avoiding tolls.

skills.name: Personalized Map Generator
skills.description: Creates custom map images or interactive map views based on user-defined points of interest, routes, and style preferences. Can overlay data layers.
tags: maps
customization
visualization
cartography
examples: Generate a map of my upcoming road trip with all planned stops highlighted.
Show me a map visualizing all coffee shops within a 1-mile radius of my current location.

tags: Nacos Console Configuration Center APIs
post.description: This interface imports configurations from a ZIP file (exported from Nacos) into a specified namespace. ** Note: The import interface currently supports ZIP files from older and newer export formats, but support for older formats will be deprecated. Use the new export interface for future compatibility.**

requestBody.description: The zip file must be the one exported via the configuration export feature. If using a self-created zip file, its content structure **must exactly match** the format of the exported zip file. Any additional directories or hidden files may cause import failure.

tags: Nacos Console Configuration Center APIs

tags: Nacos Console AI Skill Related APIs
post.description: This interface allows uploading a Skill from a ZIP file.

requestBody.description: file: ZIP file containing the skill; namespaceId: namespace ID, optional, default public; overwrite: whether to overwrite an existing draft, optional; targetVersion: target version, optional; commitMsg: version commit message, optional.

tags: Nacos Console AI Skill Related APIs
post.description: This interface uploads multiple Skills from a ZIP file that contains one-level Skill subdirectories.

requestBody.description: Multipart form: file (required, ZIP containing Skill subdirectories), namespaceId (optional, default namespace if omitted), overwrite (optional, whether to overwrite existing drafts).

tags: Nacos Console State APIs
get.description: This interface retrieves the Nacos cluster's foundational status and configuration, such as version number, operational mode, and authentication status. It does not return node-level cluster details.

tags: Nacos Console State APIs
get.description: This interface retrieves guidance information for the Nacos console. The default console UI calls this interface when the console is disabled to fetch guidance content, as detailed in the console manual's "Disable Default Console" section.

example.data: 当前节点已关闭Nacos开源控制台使用，请修改application.properties中的nacos.console.ui.enabled参数为true打开开源控制台使用，详情查看文档中关于关闭默认控制台部分。

tags: Nacos Console State APIs
get.description: This interface retrieves announcements to be displayed in the browser by the Nacos console. By default, the console UI calls this interface when authentication is not enabled to return a security warning.

example.data: Authentication has not been enabled in cluster, please refer to Documentation to enable~
